# RadioButtons { #anylumino.RadioButtons }

```python
RadioButtons(
    options=(),
    value=None,
    index=None,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
)
```

Radio-button selection control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                                    | Default   |
|-------------|----------|------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| options | optional | Selectable values or ``(label, value)`` pairs. | `()` |
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `None` |
| index | optional | Selected option index. | `None` |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control. | `''` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [control_kind](#anylumino.RadioButtons.control_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
